{"sql":"WITH counts AS (
  SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Genre g
  LEFT JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
  GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
), maxc AS (
  SELECT MAX(track_count) AS max_count FROM counts
)
SELECT c.GenreId, c.Name, c.track_count, (c.track_count = maxc.max_count) AS is_top
FROM counts c, maxc
ORDER BY c.track_count DESC, c.Name ASC;"}
